key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to check MEGAcmd while the menu is closed, in seconds.

key.name: sync-folder
key.description: Suggested parent folder in MEGA when adding a sync.

key.name: backup-folder
key.description: Suggested parent folder in MEGA when adding a backup.

key.name: terminal
key.description: Command that runs a program in a terminal, for the guided dialogs; empty finds one.

key.name: megacmd-dir
key.description: Folder holding MEGAcmd's mega-* commands, searched before the PATH; empty uses the PATH alone.

key.name: preview-name
key.description: Saved state from fixtures/ to show instead of MEGAcmd's; empty for the live state.
